title: A Survey on LLM-as-a-Judge
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey on the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm and proposes a reliability-oriented benchmark. While it includes a section on 'Ethical and Social Implications' as a challenge and mentions 'ethical reasoning' as a subset of legal domain applications, these are not core components of the paper's own benchmarking or evaluation focus, which is centered on technical reliability, consistency, and cognitive biases.
